_README: Worked-example analyst frame for fixtures/example_graph.json (the IPF repurposing demo).
Every value here is an ILLUSTRATIVE ANALYST DECISION, not a finding, and not sourced.
It exists so the hyp_gen -> LABrador handoff can be exercised end to end; it is not a
scenario anyone has defended. Replace all of it before quoting a number.
The frame carries only what a literature graph cannot: currency, geography, route, the
line of therapy, the valuation and launch years, and the patent filing year.
notes: Illustrative repurposing scenario; filing_year is a placeholder for a new-use filing and has not been checked against Orange Book.
